newsitem.title: UK: Reuters launches Equity Focus Plus product.
newsitem.headline: Reuters launches Equity Focus Plus product.

text.p: International news and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Monday it was launching Equity Focus Plus, a substantial enhancement to its UK domestic equity product.
The new product will be priced at the same level, 320 stg per terminal per month, the company said.

Reuters is also introducing a new interactive product, London Exchange Trader (LXT). It is designed to meet the London Stock Exchange member firms' requirements for the new order driven market for FTSE 100 stocks, due to start on October 20.

Equity Focus Plus will provide Reuters clients with all the features of Equity Focus as well as, for the first time, access to Reuters historical database. This facility will offer clients access to information on some 2,300 UK and Irish stocks.
All clients using the Equity Focus service will also be able to access Reuters Financial Television and the Reuters Web, a private intranet system, to send E-Mails with attachments.
LXT will enable users to view all individual orders, price and volume details and multiple best price displays.

"Backed by our international news and exchange data, these two products will place our customers in a better position than ever before. Equity Focus Plus is also particularly good value for money," Julie Holland, managing director of Reuters UK and Ireland, said in a statement.
